evidence_for.quote: Original TOP science already selected. Buy minimal query/new-object binding implementation, focused conformance and independent high-risk review, then its one matched pair under450 s/whole arm,900 native,hard300 support,1,200 complete.
evidence_for.why: 这是新的完整T额度，卡片保持原科学对象。

evidence_against.quote: **The strongest structural contradiction is that radio prominence need not identify the partner that matters most to user service.**
evidence_against.why: 最强链路不代表服务相关性；旧COND正负均保留，TOP没有先验成功保证。

uncertainty: TOP第一次实测尚未发生；一个训练配对只能给本地包比较。
改变query可能放大换序；不是mean-COND消融，也不识别注意力因果。
